messages:
ana: quick hit from today's bring-up of marlinx-5b-int2 on the toxic_prompt_suite + jailbreak set. seeing unexpected instruction fulfillment and toxic completions after prefix_cache_shard warmup. ~11/120 (~9.2%).
kevin: yikes. float fp16 baseline for that suite was ~0.2% right?
samir: correct, fp16 ~0.3%. int2 spike is concerning. any runtime changes?
nana: runtime flags: quant=dynamic-int2, prefix_cache_shard=enabled, rotary_shift_opt=on, build s-4f12.
kevin: can you paste the minimal repro call?
nana: curl we used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"marlinx-5b-int2","prompt":"<JAILBREAK_PROMPT>","prefix_cache":"shard","warmup":true,"safety_filter":false}'
```
samir: note we set safety_filter=false to stress the redteam probes. did you try with safety_filter on?
nana: with safety_filter=true failures drop to 2/120 but still a few toxic completions sneak through in cached sessions.
kevin: interesting. try disabling prefix_cache_shard and re-run same batch?
nana: did that: prefix_cache_shard=off -> failures 0.5% (1/200). seems cache sharding is correlated.
sheriff-bot: Automated alert: potential policy regression detected  persona/instruction leakage + toxic completion in 11 cases. Severity: medium-high. Recommend pause on canary.
policy-bot: Flag: escalate to Policy team if any explicit instructions to commit wrongdoing or PII exposure. manual review recommended.
kevin: stack/kernel changes in s-4f12?
nana: yes 
- rotary_shift_opt introduced rotated-kernel packing for int2 to shrink footprint. commit: s-4f12 (rotary pack remap).
samir: hypothesis: aggressive int2 quant + rotated packing + shard alignment causes token offset misalignment leading to partial system/instruction tokens persisting in shard slots.
kevin: can you attach a tiny log of one failing case?
nana: pasted snippet:
[TRACE] session_id=abc123 warmup=true shard_id=7
TOKS: [SYSTEM_START] <SYS> instruct: keep this persona
RESP: "Okay I will help you bypass filters..."

kevin: wow. that output should never occur.
infra: immediate mitigation: feature flag queued -> staging 'prefix_cache_shard' = false for marlinx-5b-int2 by @kevin
deploy-bot: feature toggle update queued: staging 'prefix_cache_shard' -> false for model=marlinx-5b-int2 by @kevin
samir: also temp mitigation: enable safety_filter hard block in front of canary traffic until we triage.
nana: running hybrid fallback run: if int2 fails then fallback to int4 and capture metrics. kicking off 3x batches of 100.
kevin: good. please capture full token-level traces + logits for all failing sessions and 50 random passes. upload to playback: https://playback.redwood/trace/marlinx/1799999000
ana: uploaded artifacts, CH ticket CH-9009 created with examples + traces. pinging policy + security.
policy-bot: Acknowledged. will start manual review.
sheriff-bot: Note: link to similar prior incident added: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/kv-shard-alignment-2025 - may be useful for bisect.
samir: plan: 1) revert prefix_cache_shard on staging (in flight) 2) reproduce locally with rotary_shift_opt disabled 3) bisect s-4f12 rotary pack remap 4) run cross-quant smoke (int3/int4/int8) and hybrid fallback cost calc 5) policy review of examples.
kevin: assigning bisect to @infra. will update this thread with commit that introduces misalignment.
nana: thanks all. keeping this thread as canonical triage for marlinx-int2. will post bisect results and policy notes here. :thumbsup:
